e01.saheli: Good morning Suresh ji, bahut badhiya ki aapne time par inhaler le liya! Chai enjoy kijiye aur apna khayal rakhiye.

Escitalopram 10 mg at 08:00. Furosemide 20 mg at 08:00. Magnesium 250 mg at 21:00. Tamsulosin 0.4 mg at 21:00. Domperidone 10 mg at 08:45. Allergies none. Doctor Dr Vikas Agarwal. Call them 'Pitaji'.
